* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Sabe, Coruscant, R
|strategy=By [mailto:joea@decipher.com Joe Alread, Decipher Game Designer]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/sabe.html</ref>

Got Amidala in your deck? Then there is no reason not to play Sab&eacute; while you're at it as well.

Sab&eacute; provides two different benefits, depending on whether you have Amidala out on the table or not:

1. Amidala not on the table? Sab&eacute; is actually the better character to pull before Amidala herself. Sab&eacute; deploys for only two Force and lets you deploy Amidala out of your Reserve Deck or Lost Pile for free, so in a sense you're actually saving Force by using Sab&eacute; over a second copy of Amidala!

2. Already have Amidala out? Sab&eacute; provides extra power in this situation and also makes the queen immune to attrition. Even if you forfeit Sab&eacute; before a battle has concluded, Amidala will keep her immunity for the remainder of that battle. (See in the Glossary.)

Advantageous in either situation above, Sab&eacute; is great in any deck that revolves around the ruler of the [[Naboo]].
